{{arma3}} comes with a variety of shooting targets. Most of these targets come with a somewhat hidden functionality which is explained on this page.


== Changing pop-up-behaviour ==

The pop-up-behaviour can be changed by setting the variable</tt>noPop</tt> in [[missionNamespace]].
<sqf>
missionNamespace setVariable ["noPop", true];	// will prevent the targets from popping up again once they were hit
missionNamespace setVariable ["noPop", false];	// targets will pop up normally again after they were hit
</sqf>


== Animating the targets ==

All of the above listed targets have an animation source called {{hl|terc}}. This can be used to change the angle of the target.
Let's say we have a pop up target place in the editor with the name {{hl|popUpTarget}}:
<sqf>
popUpTarget animateSource ["terc", 0.5];	// target will have an angle of 45°
popUpTarget animateSource ["terc", 1];		// target will have an angle of 180°
popUpTarget animateSource ["terc", 0];		// target will have an angle of 90° e.g. the target will stand up straight
</sqf>

{{Feature|informative|'''Random Fact:''' "terc" is Czech and means Object.}}


== Example mission with "noPop" and "terc" ==

# Open a new mission in [[:Category:Eden Editor|Eden Editor]] and save it.
# Place three pop-up targets. Make sure they are compatible. See {{Link|Arma 3: Shooting Targets#Targets}}.
# Name the pop-up targets {{hl|target_0}}, {{hl|target_1}}, {{hl|target_2}}.
# Place any object you would like to use to control the targets' states and name it {{hl|flag_control_targets}}.
# Navigate to ''Menu Strip'' → ''Scenario'' → ''Open Scenario Folder''.
# In that folder create a file called {{hl|initPlayerLocal.sqf}}. See [[Event Scripts]] for more information.
# Paste the following code into that file and save it. <sqf>
// Three local actions are added to the object flag_control_targets. These actions are available for every player
// Rset the animation state of all three targets
flag_control_targets addAction ["Reset Targets", { [target_0, target_1, target_2] apply { _x animateSource ["terc", 0] } }];
</sqf><sqf>
// Disable the pop-up functionality by setting "noPop" to true globally
flag_control_targets addAction ["Disable pop-up", { missionNamespace setVariable ["noPop", true, true] }];
</sqf><sqf>
// Enable the pop-up functionality by setting "noPop" to false globally. The targets will not automatically reset. Use the Reset Targets action
flag_control_targets addAction ["Enable pop-up", { missionNamespace setVariable ["noPop", false, true] }];
</sqf>
# Preview the mission and play around with the targets.

=== Interesting Scripts ===

The following scripts are used to animate the targets. Some of them only create a simply destruction effect, others are more sophisticated.
To see their content, combine [[loadFile]] with the path.
* {{hl|a3\structures_f_mark\items\sport\scripts\balloon_01_air_f_hitpart.sqf}}
